title: Upaneyyam
text: Evam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Upanīyati jīvitam appam āyu || jarūpanītassa na santi tāṇā || etaṃ bhayaṃ marane pekkhamāno || puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānī ti || || Upanīyati jīvitam appam āyu || jarūpanītassa na santi tāṇā || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho ti || || [page 003] I. 1. 6.] NAḶA-VAGGA 1. 3
